feature.label: OSGi AI Migrator for Liferay
feature.description:
AI-assisted modernization of legacy Liferay 7.x OSGi modules into Liferay Objects and Client Extensions, powered by Google Gemini (AI Studio or Vertex AI). Adds an "OSGi AI Migrator" context menu and a 4-agent migration wizard (Donatello: analyze, Leonardo: architect, Michelangelo: generate, Raphael: verify).
Independent personal project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Liferay, Inc. Liferay and Liferay DXP are trademarks of Liferay, Inc.
